description: TCNET railway train-control network simulator is provided by 鉄道総合技術研究所 (RTRI). RTRI couples TCNET network simulation with RADTRACE radio-link simulation for railway train control. The system uses track geometry, radio equipment, network protocols and train motion to estimate loss, delay and emergency-stop probability. Geographic context: global. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. The public source page provides documentation and links for obtaining the resource; no data or software archive was downloaded. Cost and access terms require confirmation with the provider. Licence: Not stated on the reviewed page; check provider terms before reuse.  RTRI offers analyses or customised executables; access requires coordination and a suitable execution environment. Reported reproduction of real network characteristics was not independently tested. Potential simulation use: Assess how wireless-network design and disruption affect train-control reliability. For catalogue navigation, platform-ns-3 offers related simulation context; this comparison does not assert an implemented connection.
